'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Jeffrey Johns DS Endor: Forest Clearing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jeffrey Johns]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jeffrey Johns]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor: Forest Clearing]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
